summary: Father and two teenage boys slid their Jeep off the Barbour Fork trail in the rain; wet and cold with no shelter since the Jeep was too precarious to shelter in, and the father's winch controller and survival bag had recently been stolen; Colorado 4x4 Rescue & Recovery volunteers responded, provided shelter and warmth, and recovered the Jeep back onto the trail.
notes: Date = the mission-report date (Friday 2019-06-21); incident occurred that day or shortly before. County per DB convention for the Barbour Forks area (Alpine one-liners).
